description: Stratégie québécoise d'économie d'eau potable 2011 à 2017 is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation. La Stratégie québécoise d’économie d’eau potable (la Stratégie) a été mise en place en mars 2011 par le ministère des Affaires municipales et de l’Habitation (MAMH) pour répondre à l’engagement 49 de la Politique nationale de l’eau. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation. Its tags are Eau potable, Fuite, Sqeep, Stratégie québécoise. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-04-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
